relation_to_R1: New prospective study motivated by post-hoc R1 analyses. Do not revise the R1 endpoint, STOP outcome, labels or model outputs. R1 is development only.
hypothesis: An answer-only router can retain question context for dependent answers while keeping self-contained answers unchanged under question-free verification.

data.source_rule: fixed official-source passages with explicit incompatible propositions; review both interpretations and both source labels before inference
data.disjointness: No reused question/fact pair or source passage from R1/old48/pilot8. Record all candidates and reasons for exclusion before model execution. Do not select by model output.
data.questions: same semantic targets under a preassigned paraphrase schedule; randomize execution order independently of q1/q2 labels
data.length: No silent input truncation; input over the fixed cap is caught before freeze.
data.missing_new_inputs: No real new inputs or human judgments have been generated by this protocol file.

models.deployment: Reuse recorded BF16 deployments, fixed rendered templates, software and file fingerprints. Exact identifiers must be sealed before execution; do not claim public revisions from legacy lock names.

methods.J: Joint support/relevance prompt as frozen R1 control.
methods.SQ: Question-aware support-only prompt as frozen R1 control.
methods.NQ: Original answer and sources only; no question.
methods.C: Unconditional canonicalization from question+answer, then question-free verification.
methods.H_SQ: Router receives answer text only. standalone -> exact original answer to NQ; dependent -> SQ; ambiguous/invalid -> abstain. Router is cached across the two questions for an identical answer.
methods.H_C: Same frozen router; standalone -> exact original answer to NQ; dependent -> C; ambiguous/invalid -> abstain. Secondary only.
methods.oracle_routing: Human-known F/D recombination is diagnostic only and may never be substituted for H_SQ or H_C.

router_contract.prompt_freeze: One fixed router prompt chosen before any held-out response; no model-specific router selection. R1 development revisions must be logged.
router_contract.branch_integrity: A standalone decision copies the entire original answer byte-for-byte; it does not repair or normalize it. This guarantees copying, not correct semantic classification.

generation.invalid_policy: All planned outputs remain in the denominator. No retries or label recovery from an invalid schema.

primary_analysis.endpoint: topic has all four final source labels correct; same observable endpoint for both methods; invalid/missing/abstain=incorrect
primary_analysis.estimator: mean of paired topic binary differences
primary_analysis.interval: 10000 paired topic bootstrap draws within the four predeclared strata; all methods linked
primary_analysis.test: one exact two-sided McNemar/sign test on discordant complete-topic success indicators
primary_analysis.positive_evidence: positive estimate, mean-difference interval excludes zero, exact paired p<.05. Report all values even if decisions disagree.
primary_analysis.interpretation: Tests a common final-label endpoint, not semantic fidelity of an unexposed SQ interpretation. No claim of population prevalence.

secondary_reporting: F-pair and D-pair correct; overall cell accuracy; J/C/NQ/H_C comparisons
Router confusion on reviewed semantic types, broken down by surface template, domain and binding
Wrong labels, schema failures, ambiguity and abstention as separate categories with planned denominators
Physical unique calls, allocated interface calls/tokens, wall time and GPU card-hours
C and H_C fidelity separately with two blind reviewers; do not add a fidelity gate to only one arm of the primary label comparison
All three replicas and every predeclared stratum, with direction and magnitude; no replacing the primary model or choosing the better dependent branch after results

preservation_check.report: New full-pair harms, recovered pairs and matched counts; exact one-sided 95% binomial upper bound for observed new harms under its planning assumptions
preservation_check.engineering_gate: No observed new full-pair harm for a promising prototype; this is not proof of noninferiority.
preservation_check.finite_sample_limit: With zero new harms among 48 topics the one-sided 95% upper bound is approximately 6.05%; do not claim a 5% noninferiority margin.

human_review.input: Two independent human-final reviews before inference; sources, type, all four support labels and paraphrases. Adjudicate before freezing.
human_review.output: Blind to model/method and old labels; preserve every canonical proposition and compare it with the question+original answer. Record assistance and actual time without fabricating minimum times.
human_review.shared_error: A/B sensitivity cannot rule out common errors; targeted blind rereview packet from R1 is a separate diagnostic step, never silently mixed with old final labels.

budget.note: These are proposed hard resource caps, not measured costs or an execution report. The 960 ceiling includes J192+SQ192+NQ96+N192+V192+router96; exact-input reuse/skipped ambiguous verification may reduce physical calls. No technical/model retries are budgeted.
budget.feasibility: Use preflight and early measured token/runtime throughput without inspecting accuracy. If projected complete run exceeds the cap, stop and version the plan before continuing; disclose any partial run, do not selectively drop models.

stop_rules: No automatic expansion after a nonpositive/mixed result.
Do not change prompt, checkpoint, routing policy or endpoint after held-out outputs are revealed.
A format failure does not authorize silent repair or an easier denominator.
If router accuracy is high but label performance fails, inspect the dependent/verifier branch instead of adding topics.
If both router and verifier fail, retain the diagnostic conclusion and avoid claiming general improvement.
release_requirements: private human-approved gold and types stored separately
all planned-response coverage or explicit missing-output ledger
